hooks.command: f="$HOME/.claude/scripts/k10-stop-gate.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then for py in python3 python; do if "$py" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$py" "$f"; fi; done; printf '{"systemMessage":"K10 钩子找不到能运行的 Python(python3 / python 都跑不起来),本次不检查"}\n'; else printf '{"systemMessage":"K10 钩子脚本未安装：%s（见 WORKFLOW.md「K10 第三者」部署），本次不检查"}\n' "$f"; fi

f="$HOME/.claude/scripts/k10-subagent-report.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then for py in python3 python; do if "$py" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$py" "$f"; fi; done; printf '{"systemMessage":"K10 钩子找不到能运行的 Python(python3 / python 都跑不起来),本次不检查"}\n'; else printf '{"systemMessage":"K10 钩子脚本未安装：%s（见 WORKFLOW.md「K10 第三者」部署），本次不检查"}\n' "$f"; fi
